# proxmox_replication_job (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE storage replication job configuration through `/cluster/replication`. This resource never runs a replication job. Destroy removes only the job configuration with `force=1`; it does not clean up replication snapshots or target data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_replication_job" "database" {
  job_id   = "101-0"
  target   = "pve-2"
  schedule = "*/15"
  rate     = 50
  comment  = "Replicate database guest"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_id` (String) Stable job identifier in `<guest>-<job-number>` form. Changes require replacement.
- `target` (String) Target cluster node. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Job description.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable scheduled replication.
- `rate` (Number) Rate limit in megabytes per second.
- `schedule` (String) Replication schedule as a Proxmox calendar event. The server default is `*/15`.

### Read-Only

- `guest_id` (Number) Guest ID derived by Proxmox from `job_id`.
- `id` (String) Replication job identifier.
- `job_number` (Number) Job number derived by Proxmox from `job_id`.
- `source` (String) Observed source node used internally by Proxmox.
- `type` (String) Observed replication section type (`local`).
